name: workload
how: 21 models x60 exact archived targets; all arms share workload SHA and original source equation.

name: instrument
how: One immutable source commit, lockfile, flags, binary and image for all arms; unresolved hashes block freezing.

name: threads
how: Single method thread; pin physical-core placement and SMT sibling exclusion before execution.

name: host
how: Record instance ID/type, CPU model/microcode, SMT, affinity, NUMA, kernel, hypervisor, governor/frequency, steal, PSI, co-tenants and isolation blockers. Reject timed rows below L2; no cross-host timing pooling after recovery.

name: placement
how: Dedicated qualified L2 c8a.2xlarge Spot placement; no heterogeneous fallback.

name: memory_environment
how: 8GiB execution cap, same allocator preparation/environment for every arm; record actual RSS, allocator, ASLR and resolved environment. No memory-cap increase.

name: arm_order
how: Use existing prepared spec shuffle rule and seed2026101801; freeze emitted plan bytes before data. Interleave all three arms in each workload/round.

name: algorithm_stream
how: Five predetermined measured streams per workload shared exactly across all three arms; index0 preserves archived seed; indices1..4 are new streams, not repeat measurements of index0.

name: warmup
how: One warmup execution per arm/workload; retain records but exclude from ratios.

name: preemption
how: Retain checkpoint, interruption and restore records; resumed execution clocks invalid. Restart only under frozen infrastructure retry limit, never restart a scientific cap.

name: analyst
how: Unblinded deterministic native exporter; no hand-selected workloads, thresholds or best stream. External reviewer receives all rows and reasons.

name: rho_hash_policy
how: Retain DefaultHasher/BuildHasherDefault policy version1 and exact resolved rho semantics. Actual final compiler/source/binary pins are unresolved and must establish equivalence; do not silently import historical clock comparability.

name: finite_operation_model
how: pencil-algorithm-cost/atomic-scalar-disjoint-v1; source-bound nine-category independent coverage required.36cells, symmetric scalar inverse normalization, disjoint primitive registry, separate algorithm/calibration/resource boundaries.

name: diagnostic_callbacks_and_publication
how: Same prospective instrument/profile across all three arms; bind exact callback and I/O semantics and retain costs. Source parity alone cannot qualify timing.

name: owner_and_campaign_enforcement
how: One owner and one active scientific payload; fixed authenticated accounting/stop semantics; actual job/pod/session IDs measured and bound after preparation.

name: legacy_reuse
how: Prior p739 exact fresh-row finite equivalence/replay must be reviewed for changed instrument; old clocks remain invalid and are never pooled into qualified fresh timing.
